request.style: English, soul, powerful female solo voice with gospel choir, piano, drums, bass guitar, organ, hopeful and triumphant, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I am afflicted and in pain
Let your salvation lift me high
Out of the dust and out of shame
I see your light in the sky

[Chorus]
I will praise the name of God with song
I will magnify him with thanksgiving
This will please the LORD more than an ox
More than a bull with horns and hooves

[Verse]
You who seek God let your hearts revive
The humble will see it and be glad
For the LORD hears the needy cry
He does not despise his own in chains

[Chorus]
I will praise the name of God with song
I will magnify him with thanksgiving
This will please the LORD more than an ox
More than a bull with horns and hooves

[Outro]
I will praise the name of God with song
This will please the LORD more than an ox
